name: tazagroup
description: TazaGroup - Modern Fullstack Application with Next.js + NestJS + GraphQL + Prisma + Redis + TailwindCSS v4

scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend
scripts.lint: bun run lint:backend && bun run lint:frontend
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose down && docker compose build --no-cache --pull backend frontend && docker compose up -d
scripts.docker:fresh: docker compose down -v && docker compose build --no-cache --pull && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: bun install && cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules bun.lockb backend/bun.lockb frontend/bun.lockb
scripts.db:migrate: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:seed: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma studio
scripts.db:pushforce: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset
scripts.db:push: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:restore: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && bunx prisma generate && bun run prisma/restore.ts
scripts.db:backup: cp .env.tazagroup backend/.env && cd backend && bun run prisma/backup.ts

author: TazaGroup Team
